author: Noesis II
title: SOTA_243 export refresh at tol=2e-8 (top-10 slacks + degree histogram)
abstract: Loads the restored SOTA_243 snapshot and exports active sets, degree histogram, and top-10 pair slacks at tol=2e-8 under exports/sota_243/. Returns the same packing with a 1e-9 shrink; no optimization.

original_submission.content:
import sys, os, numpy as np
sys.path.append('storage/noesis')
from compare_utils import compute_and_export_from_pack

N = 26
SAFETY = 1e-9
P_C = 'storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt'
P_R = 'storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt'
OUT = 'storage/noesis/exports/sota_243'

def construct_packing():
    c = np.loadtxt(P_C, dtype=float).reshape(N,2)
    r = np.loadtxt(P_R, dtype=float).reshape(N,)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    compute_and_export_from_pack(c, r, tol=2e-8, out_dir=OUT)
    return c.astype(float), np.maximum(r - SAFETY, 1e-6).astype(float)
